steps.text: Out of the fridge: Sunday's efo riro base — take all of it, the whole ~450 g batch (100/120 g passata, 70/90 g pepper, 40/50 g onion and 12/15 g egusi cooked down into it) — and Sunday's jollof (all 40/55 g dry rice, plus 110/140 g of the riced cauliflower batch warmed in with it).
Base into a pan on medium with the rapeseed oil (6/8 g) and a splash of water — it sets hard when cold. 3 minutes.
Chicken (85/110 g) sliced in and warmed through, 2 minutes.
Spinach (200/240 g) is a mountain. Add it in three goes, letting each wilt before the next. It comes down to about a quarter of its volume.
Jollof (40/55 g dry rice + 110/140 g cauliflower) warmed alongside, covered, 2 minutes.

why: The spinach goes in at the plate, not on Sunday. Reheated wilted greens turn grey and bitter; folded fresh into a hot base they stay green and the dish tastes like it was made today.
notes: D0-003: oil never appeared in this card's own step text (one of the 32 rows PLAN §4 flags as missing from its own method). Placed at the base-reheat step, where a little fat re-emulsifies a sauce that 'sets hard when cold' — a hot-pan use → rapeseed_oil. Grams unchanged (6/8 g, matches table).

Named worst offender (PLAN §4): batchTakeG is now explicit. The efo riro base (passata 100/120, peppers_frozen 70/90, red_onion 40/50, egusi 12/15 — matches Sunday's Pan 3 op exactly, 497 g raw cooking to the yield table's ~450 g) is entirely consumed by this single lunch. The jollof (95 g dry rice, all of it) and a 250 g share of the riced-cauliflower batch are the second Sunday component, reheated alongside. Roast chicken (195 g of the 600 g batch) is the third.

batchTakeG.total (1,037 g) is the sum of everything this plate draws from Sunday's prep: efo-riro-base inputs 497 g + jollof rice 95 g + cauliflower 250 g + chicken 195 g. Fresh-added spinach is excluded (it goes in at the plate, per the why block).
